**Job Title:** Principal Software Engineer

**Location**: Onsite - Huntsville, AL

**Salary Range****:** $166,400.00 - $208,000, plus bonus eligible

**Company Overview**

Founded in 2004 with locations in Atlanta, GA, Fort Worth, TX, Denver, CO, & Huntsville, AL, Thompson Software Solutions (TSS) is a mission-driven aerospace and defense software and systems engineering company supporting the U.S. military, defense primes, and commercial space partners. We specialize in the development, integration, test, and deployment of safety & mission-critical software systems that power next-generation aircraft, defense platforms, and space technologies. Our team understands what it takes to modernize complex embedded systems while maintaining the rigor, compliance, and reliability required for mission and safety-critical environments.

As a defense-focused company of highly skilled and dedicated engineers, we take pride in solving complex technical challenges that directly impact national security and operational readiness. We partner closely with customers across the military aviation and space domains to deliver resilient, future-ready solutions with portability, sustainability, and long-term mission success in mind.

**Description**

**Thompson Software Solutions** is seeking a **Principal Software Engineer** to support the development of embedded flight software capabilities for an advanced missile platform. This role offers the opportunity to lead the design and integration of mission-critical software operating in high-performance, real-time environments where precision, reliability, and deterministic execution are paramount.

This position requires a software engineer to use a wide application of technical principles, theories, and concepts in the software field to develop, integrate, and test software products. The successful candidate will be a member of a high-performing multi-site team and must be self-motivated with a strong work ethic, time-management, and interpersonal skills. In this role, you will work independently at times on projects, at other times will be in a collaborative team environment with other software engineers, as well as other program development and deployment teams.

Selected applicants will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. Continued eligibility for access to classified information is required throughout employment, as dictated by program needs.

**Basic Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in STEM discipline
* 8+ years of embedded software development
* Experience developing embedded software in C/C++
* Experience with I&T integration and test.
* Experience with Full Lifecycle Software Development
* Experience with (FSW) Flight software engineering
* Familiarity with Model-Based System Engineering (MBSE) concepts and tools (Cameo, AADL)
* Proficient with Linux and Windows development environments
* Ability to professionally communicate project status and collaborate on technical solutions with clients and peers
* Active Secret Clearance Required
* Ability to work onsite 100%
* Ability to travel 10%

**Preferred / Additional Skills**

* Proficient with Atlassian Tools (Confluence, JIRA, Bitbucket, etc.)
* Proficient in Python development
* Experience with Digital Simulation Development and integration
* Experience with safety-critical software development and practices (DO-178C)
* Experience with Navigation, Guidance and Control Implementation
* Experience with Signal Processing Implementation
* Experience developing Embedded Flight Software
* Experience communicating and documenting complex technical designs
* Ability to work in a collaborative and team-based environment
* Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills

**Sound Exciting?** Get in touch today! We have very robust benefits including:

* Low-cost Medical / Dental / Vision coverage options
* 401K with generous employer match
* Responsible Paid Time Off + Paid Holidays

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**ABOUT MIND:**
---------------

Mind Robotics is building Physical AI for real-world industrial deployment, starting with the factory floor. We believe the hardest problems in AI are solved when researchers and engineers are hands-on with the physical world every day - and we're looking for people who are passionate about robotics, value ownership, and are excited to tackle difficult problems. Join us if you want to move beyond digital intelligence and put intelligence into motion.

**THE ROLE:**
-------------

At Mind Robotics, we're building generalized physical AI — robotic systems capable of dexterous, adaptive, reasoning-intensive and most importantly safe work in real-world industrial environments. Systems engineering is the discipline that holds it all together: translating mission requirements into hardware reality and ensuring every subsystem behaves as a coherent whole.

We're looking for a Systems Engineer to own the requirements and architecture baseline for the robot — from decomposing high-level behaviors into measurable, traceable specs, to making sure the system and its safety requirements hold together from concept through field deployment. You'll define how the robot is supposed to behave, how we prove it, and what "ready to ship" means, working alongside software, mechanical, electrical, and integration teams.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**
---------------------

* Own the system requirements baseline: capture top-level robot behaviors and performance targets, and decompose them into measurable subsystem requirements, budgets, and interfaces, with traceability through to verification
* Define software requirements from high-level system requirements, using first-principles analysis and hardware/model-based testing
* Contribute to architectural decisions for new robot subsystems — communication protocols, control strategies, and hardware-software partitioning — alongside firmware/controls, mechanical, and electrical teams
* Own interface definitions across mechanical, electrical, firmware, controls, and software, and manage requirement and interface changes and their cross-subsystem impact
* Lead system-level failure mode and hazard analysis (DFMEA, HARA, FTA) together with subsystem owners, and derive, allocate, and trace the resulting safety requirements to subsystems and their verification
* Work cross-functionally to drive the verification and validation strategy: system-level test plans from bench testing through field deployment, acceptance criteria, and requirements coverage
* Work cross-functionally with subsystem owners to drive requirements and system-level coverage for on-robot diagnostics, telemetry, and health monitoring that support field deployment and service
* Drive readiness reviews, sign-off, and post-launch monitoring across firmware, hardware, controls, reliability, and manufacturing stakeholders
* Work with integration engineers to turn bench and field findings into requirement, interface, and design changes

**REQUIREMENTS:**
-----------------

* Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Robotics, or equivalent experience
* 5+ years in systems engineering on complex electromechanical, robotic, or autonomous products, including at least one product taken through to field deployment
* Demonstrated experience writing, decomposing, and managing requirements — making high-level system behaviors measurable and testable, with traceability from requirement to design to verification
* Hands-on experience with hazard and risk analysis (DFMEA/FMEDA, HARA, FTA) and turning the results into requirements and test cases
* Working knowledge of functional safety standards and concepts (IEC 61508, ISO 13849, IEC 62061, ISO 26262, or similar)
* Strong hardware and software fundamentals — able to bridge electrical schematics, embedded communication protocols, and firmware architecture, and to debug system-level issues alongside integration and firmware engineers
* Proficient in data analysis and scripting — able to use hardware and field data to validate or challenge requirements
* Clear written and verbal communication — specs that mechanical, electrical, and firmware teams can all build and test against
* You are comfortable with ambiguity, move fast, and have an "engineering curiosity" that drives you to understand how the entire system works, not just your part

**NICE TO HAVE:**
-----------------

* Experience with requirements management tools (Jama, Polarion, DOORS, etc.) or model-based systems engineering (SysML)
* Experience supporting product safety certification (NRTL or notified body) as a technical contributor
* Experience specifying or validating systems that include learned/ML-based components
* Background in robotics, EV powertrains, drones, aerospace, or other dense electromechanical systems
* Exposure to manufacturing self-test design or service diagnostics

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Subsense**
------------------

Subsense is a deep-tech company developing the world’s first non-surgical, bidirectional brain-computer interface powered by plasmonic and magnetoelectric nanoparticles. Our mission is to unlock direct communication between the human brain and AI - starting with medical applications such as stroke recovery and moving toward cognitive enhancement for healthy users. Headquartered in Palo Alto, Subsense brings together leading scientists and engineers to redefine the future of human–machine interaction.

### **The Opportunity**

Design, develop, and integrate electronics and hardware for emerging neurotechnology, biotechnology, and medical-device systems. You will contribute to the development of experimental platforms, proof-of-concept devices, data acquisition systems, and integrated hardware supporting a range of research and development activities. Projects may involve electronics for optical, magnetic, sensing, and other biomedical technologies as technical needs evolve.

This role offers an opportunity for an early-career engineer to gain hands-on experience across electrical engineering, biomedical instrumentation, and multidisciplinary system development. You will work on hardware from initial concepts and circuit designs through prototyping, integration, characterization, and testing, with opportunities to independently develop electrical subsystems and experimental solutions.

Working closely with specialists in engineering, neuroscience, biology, and software, you will help translate experimental requirements into functional hardware systems. The ideal candidate is curious, enjoys building and troubleshooting physical systems, and has a strong interest in applying engineering principles to biotechnology, biomedical research, and neurotechnology.

### **What You'll Own**

* Assist engineers with the assembly, integration, and testing of electronic circuits and hardware prototypes for biomedical instrumentation and neurotechnology applications.
* Build and modify circuits, cables, and test assemblies using schematics, wiring diagrams, and team guidance, including soldering, component installation, and basic rework.
* Support PCB bring-up and debugging by performing initial checks, taking measurements, recording results, and helping investigate issues.
* Assist with schematic updates, circuit simulation, component research, and straightforward PCB layout tasks under engineering supervision.
* Help set up and operate data acquisition systems, including connecting sensors, configuring equipment, and checking acquired signals.
* Support the integration of sensors, actuators, power supplies, embedded controllers, and other components into team-developed experimental platforms.
* Write or modify small scripts for instrument control, data collection, and test automation using existing code, examples, and team guidance.
* Perform electrical measurements using oscilloscopes, multimeters, function generators, and bench power supplies, following established procedures.
* Help troubleshoot circuit and system issues, document observations, and work with engineers to identify next steps.
* Apply basic signal analysis and filtering techniques to review measurement quality and help identify noise or unexpected behavior.
* Assist with the assembly and modification of fixtures, enclosures, mounts, and other mechanical components used in laboratory setups.
* Maintain clear records of hardware configurations, wiring, test procedures, measurements, and changes to support repeatable experiments.
* Follow laboratory safety practices and team procedures for handling, powering, and testing electronic hardware.
* Participate in design reviews and team discussions, communicate progress and questions, and incorporate feedback into your work.

### **What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, biomedical engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline with coursework in electronics.
* 0–2 years of relevant experience. Recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Coursework, academic research, internships, laboratory work, and personal projects all count as relevant experience.
* Foundational understanding of circuit analysis, analog and digital electronics, and basic electronic components.
* Hands-on experience assembling and testing circuits through coursework, laboratory work, or projects.
* Basic ability to read circuit schematics and use common laboratory equipment, such as multimeters and oscilloscopes.
* Some experience with soldering, wiring, or electronic assembly, and a willingness to develop these skills.
* Basic programming experience in Python, C, or C++, with a willingness to learn tools used for hardware control and data acquisition.
* A methodical approach to troubleshooting, including taking measurements, recording observations, and asking for guidance when needed.
* Ability to follow test procedures, maintain clear technical notes, and communicate results and questions.
* Willingness to learn from feedback and work collaboratively with engineers and scientists from different backgrounds.
* Interest in biomedical engineering, biotechnology, neurotechnology, or scientific instrumentation.

Nice to have

* Exposure to schematic capture, circuit simulation, or PCB layout tools through coursework or projects.
* Experience with microcontrollers, development boards, or basic embedded programming.
* Familiarity with communication interfaces such as I2C, SPI, UART, or USB.
* Experience using Python to collect, plot, or analyze experimental data.
* Exposure to sensors, signal conditioning, data acquisition, or basic signal processing.
* Experience with 3D CAD, 3D printing, or assembling mechanical fixtures and enclosures.
* Introductory knowledge of optics, electromagnetics, bioelectrical signals, or biomedical instrumentation.
* Familiarity with version control or collaborative technical documentation.

jobs.description:
Meta's Wearables Media Codec and Framework team develops the video encoding and media capture software that powers wearable experiences. We are looking for a Video Codec Software Engineer to build and optimize codec implementations and hardware-accelerated media pipelines for resource-constrained devices like smart glasses.In this role, you will own technical problems from camera capture through encoding, media containers, and audio/video synchronization. You will balance compression efficiency, visual quality, latency, power consumption, thermal limits, and memory usage, working across media frameworks, firmware, and kernel drivers. Partnering with camera, hardware, and silicon teams, you will help define the architecture and technical direction of wearable media systems.  
  
  

### **Software Engineer, Video SWE Responsibilities:**

* Architect, implement, and troubleshoot video codec and media capture pipelines for wearable devices, from camera capture through encoding and media output
* Develop, configure, and tune video encoders, including rate control and compression algorithms, to improve encoding efficiency and visual quality
* Optimize codec performance within device power, thermal, latency, and memory constraints, using profiling and measurement to evaluate trade-offs
* Integrate hardware-accelerated video codecs with mobile and embedded media stacks, working across application processor frameworks, firmware, and kernel drivers
* Develop and improve media container handling, timestamp management, and audio/video synchronization across the capture and encoding pipeline
* Diagnose and resolve video artifacts, synchronization issues, and performance regressions through codec-level and end-to-end system debugging
* Lead technical design and execution for complex media projects, partnering with camera, hardware, and silicon teams to define interfaces, resolve integration challenges, and guide technical roadmaps
* Build and improve automated tests and regression infrastructure for code correctness, visual quality, performance, and power consumption

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or relevant technical field
* 7+ years software development experience in industry settings or PhD with 4+ years of experience
* 3+ years relevant video software engineering experience in industry settings with understanding of multimedia stack, codecs, containers
* Experience in C/C++ multithreaded programming
* Experience in C/C++ multithreaded programming
* Experience leading large or complex projects, defined goals and delivered milestones by leading teams

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with image compression and formats such as JPEG, HEIC/HEIF, or raw/Bayer compression
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience developing automated media regression tests or working with codec tools and libraries such as FFmpeg, libavcodec, x264/x265
* Experience integrating hardware-accelerated video encoding on mobile or low-power systems-on-chip, using media interfaces such as Android MediaCodec, Codec2, OpenMAX, or V4L2
* Knowledge of codec internals, including rate control, motion estimation, intra/inter prediction, rate-distortion optimization, and bitstream analysis
* Experience with media-path firmware or kernel drivers, camera capture integration, or direct collaboration with silicon vendors on hardware-software integration
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience evaluating visual quality using metrics such as PSNR, SSIM, or VMAF, and diagnosing compression artifacts and quality regressions
* Experience with media containers such as MP4/ISOBMFF, muxing and demuxing, timestamp management, and audio/video synchronization
* Experience designing and optimizing media software within power, thermal, latency, and memory bandwidth constraints on wearable, mobile, or embedded devices
* Experience implementing, configuring, or tuning production video encoders using standards such as H.264/AVC, H.265/HEVC, VP9, AV1
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

jobs.description:
About us:

At Viasat, the work you do helps people stay connected in ways that matter, from everyday moments to critical missions across air, land, sea, and space.

We’re a place for people who are curious, bold, and motivated by meaningful work. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, explore new possibilities, and grow your career in ways that align with your interests and goals. When you're ready to take on something new, you'll find leaders who support your development and help you turn your ambition into action.

What you'll do:

At Viasat, we're building the next generation of global connectivity by seamlessly integrating terrestrial 5G networks with advanced satellite communications. Our Access Edge Terminal Software team develops the embedded software that powers innovative connectivity solutions across aviation, maritime, residential, automotive, and emerging mobility markets.

We are seeking a **Staff Embedded Software Engineers - 5G Devices & NTN Connectivity** to architect and develop software platforms for 5G User Equipment (UE) and Customer Premises Equipment (CPE). In this role, you will combine industry-leading 5G technologies with Viasat's satellite capabilities to create hybrid connectivity solutions that deliver reliable communications wherever customers operate.

This is a highly impactful engineering position focused on device-side software architecture, embedded Linux development, modem integration, and platform design. You will work closely with chipset vendors, hardware teams, and product stakeholders to define and deliver next-generation connected devices.

**Note:** This position focuses on device/UE software architecture and development and is distinct from RAN (gNodeB/base station) or 5G Core network roles. Candidates should have experience with device-side, client-side, or CPE software development rather than network infrastructure technologies.

The day-to-day:

**Software Architecture & Platform Development**

* Design and implement modular software architectures with reusable building blocks for devices operating on Viasat's satellite and NTN networks.
* Develop hardware abstraction layers (HALs), middleware, and platform services that decouple application software from modem and hardware implementations.
* Create scalable software frameworks that support multiple device variants, deployment models, and market-specific requirements.
* Define robust APIs and interfaces that enable independent development, testing, and lifecycle management of software components.
* Balance architectural flexibility, maintainability, and performance in resource-constrained embedded environments.

**5G Modem Integration & Embedded Development**

* Integrate 5G modem solutions from industry-leading vendors such as Qualcomm, MediaTek, Intel, and other ecosystem partners.
* Develop and maintain Linux kernel drivers supporting modem interfaces including PCIe, USB, SDIO, and UART.
* Implement software responsible for modem initialization, configuration, power management, diagnostics, and runtime operation.
* Customize vendor Board Support Packages (BSPs) to meet Viasat hardware and product requirements.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex hardware-software integration challenges.
* Optimize system performance for latency, throughput, power efficiency, reliability, and stability.

**Reference Architectures & Partner Enablement**

* Design and maintain reference software architectures used by OEM and ODM partners.
* Create SDKs that include software libraries, sample applications, documentation, and development tools.
* Develop "golden reference" implementations demonstrating best practices for building 5G NTN-enabled devices compatible with Viasat networks.
* Provide technical guidance and support to external development partners.
* Ensure reference platforms align with industry standards and evolving ecosystem requirements.
* Balance platform standardization with flexibility to support diverse partner and market needs.

**System Integration & Validation**

* Collaborate with hardware and systems engineering teams to define device architectures and software-hardware interfaces.
* Develop automated test frameworks and validation solutions for software platform verification.
* Perform software profiling, performance analysis, and end-to-end optimization.
* Support field trials, customer deployments, and production issue resolution activities.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Partner with chipset vendor field application engineers (FAEs) and technical specialists to resolve complex integration challenges.
* Collaborate with product management to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Work closely with application development teams to ensure platform capabilities support future product needs.
* Mentor engineers on embedded systems, 5G device technologies, Linux development, and software engineering best practices.

What you'll need:

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 8+ years of experience developing embedded software for wireless communication devices.
* Proven track record delivering commercial 5G UE or CPE products.
* Familiarity with 5G device architecture, including RF, baseband, and application processor subsystems.
* Hands-on experience integrating 5G modem chipsets from vendors such as Qualcomm, MediaTek, Intel, or Samsung.
* Knowledge of 3GPP UE protocol stacks including NAS, SDAP, RRC, PDCP, RLC, MAC, and PHY layers from a device perspective.
* Familiarity with 5G NR procedures, MIMO technologies, carrier aggregation, and device performance optimization.
* Familiarity with regulatory and certification requirements including FCC, CE, and carrier approvals.

**Software & Systems Expertise**

* Proficiency in C/C++ for embedded and system-level programming.
* Strong experience with Linux kernel

* Practical experience architecting, designing, configuring, implementing, testing, and certifying network devices.

jobs.title: Principal Robotic Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
### **About the Role**

Join a defense technology team developing autonomous directed-energy systems. As the senior technical anchor for controls, you will shape precision pointing and tracking architecture, from theory and simulation through real-world hardware testing.

### **What You'll Do**

* Design control architecture for coarse gimbals and fine steering mirrors, including bandwidth allocation, multi-rate operation, and stage handoffs.
* Develop Kalman, interacting multiple model, and nonlinear filters that fuse radar, EO/IR, and inertial data into latency-compensated aimpoint estimates.
* Build line-of-sight stabilization and jitter-rejection methods, including inertial stabilization, feedforward, and adaptive or notch filtering for structural modes.
* Allocate pointing error budgets across jitter, bias, latency, and atmospheric effects, then validate precision performance against dynamic targets in field tests.
* Model plants and identify system dynamics for gimbals, mirrors, and structures, using simulation and hardware-in-the-loop validation.
* Analyze stability and robustness under disturbances and parameter variation, and integrate controls with tracking, engagement sequencing, and safety logic.
* Deploy control algorithms to embedded targets, collaborate on kilohertz-rate loops, and compare field test results with simulation predictions.
* Provide technical review across controls and sensor integration, and mentor engineers through hands-on technical leadership.

### **What We're Looking For**

* At least 10 years of experience closing loops on precision pointing, tracking, or stabilization hardware, with PhD-level depth in control theory and estimation.
* Proficiency in robust control, including H-infinity, mu-synthesis, and LQG, plus optimal estimation such as Kalman variants, IMM, and nonlinear observers.
* Experience shipping C or C++ control loops on embedded or RTOS targets, and working with MATLAB/Simulink and Python.
* Background in sensor fusion, multi-rate and sampled-data design, real-time hardware-in-the-loop validation, system identification, and structural dynamics.
* Ability to serve as the controls technical anchor on a small team. Directed-energy or high-energy laser experience and an active security clearance, or ability to obtain one, are advantages.

### **Compensation & Benefits**

Base salary range: $250,000 to $315,000 annually. Equity and visa sponsorship details were not provided.

### **Location**

On-site in San Francisco, United States.

jobs.title: Senior Hardware Engineer
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft’s expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft’s “Intelligent Cloud” mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Teams, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for engineers to help achieve that mission.

The Methodology, Infrastructure, Silicon Engineering, and Labs engineering (MILE) team delivers the physical design CAD flows, tools, and infrastructure that Microsoft’s silicon design teams use to take advanced-node chips from RTL to tapeout. Within MILE, the Physical Design (PD) CAD signoff group owns logic signoff, including formal equivalency checking, ECO verification, and low-power verification. Our flows are how design teams prove their silicon is functionally correct before tapeout, so quality here directly protects schedule, cost, and silicon quality across Microsoft’s cloud and AI programs.

We are looking for a Senior PD CAD Equivalency Engineer to own and evolve our formal equivalency flows, working with design teams and EDA vendors to deliver reliable, high-quality equivalency checking for Microsoft’s next-generation silicon.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Own the end-to-end formal equivalency CAD flow, including RTL-to-netlist, netlist-to-netlist, functional ECO, and low-power (UPF-aware) verification, for Microsoft’s silicon programs
* Develop, debug, and maintain production flows and automation in Tcl and Python for Synopsys Formality and Cadence Conformal, including handling of complex design classes
* Partner with physical design, front-end/synthesis, and signoff teams and with EDA vendors (Synopsys, Cadence) to qualify new tool releases, resolve critical tool issues, and support design teams through tapeout closure
* Independently drive technical decisions for the equivalency domain, identify root causes of ambiguous tool behavior, and define clear paths to resolution; mentor and serve as a backup for other engineers in the team
* Deliver measurable improvements in flow quality, runtime, and reliability, including regression coverage, documentation, and support turnaround for design teams

  
**Qualifications**

Required Qualifications:

* Doctorate in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 1+ year(s) technical engineering experience OR Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 4+ years technical engineering experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 5+ years technical engineering experience OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
* This role will require access to information that is controlled for export under export control regulations, potentially under the U.S. International Traffic in Arms Regulations or Export Administration Regulations, the EU Dual Use Regulation, and/or other export control regulations. As a condition of employment, the successful candidate will be required to provide either proof of their country of citizenship or proof of their US. residency or other protected status (e.g., under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)) for assessment of eligibility to access the export-controlled information. To meet this legal requirement, and as a condition of employment, the successful candidate’s citizenship will be verified with a valid passport. Lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees may verify status using other documents, where applicable.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Doctorate in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 3+ years technical engineering experience OR Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience OR equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of experience in silicon CAD, physical design (logic synthesis), or design verification flows using tools such as Synopsys Fusion Compiler/Design Compiler and/or Cadence Genus/Innovus
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with formal equivalency checking tools (Synopsys Formality and/or Cadence Conformal) in advanced process nodes
* Proficiency in scripting and automation using Tcl and Python for developing and debugging production CAD flows
* Experience with ECO flows, including functional-metal ECO and low-power (UPF-aware) equivalency verification
* Experience qualifying and deploying EDA tool releases and working with vendor application engineers to drive issue resolution; familiarity with both Synopsys and Cadence equivalency tools
* Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with distributed design and CAD teams and translate complex tradeoffs into clear next steps
* Experience supporting multiple concurrent tapeouts and familiarity with cloud-based EDA compute environments

**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We believe powerful AI can compress a century of scientific progress into a decade. Bringing Claude to scientists and engineers is a big part of building toward that future.

Claude has already helped uncover a novel enzyme system, formalize Fermat’s Last Theorem, design more efficient quantum circuits, and compute new results in theoretical physics — and this is just the beginning. You’ll figure out what scientists and engineers need from Claude and build it from 0 1.

You’ll be a technical leader with a high degree of autonomy, helping clear the path to harnessing scientific AGI. You’ll work with internal experts and industry partners. Initiatives like our AI for Science Program will connect you with researchers we support in high-impact work across scientific fields.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Build products that unlock scientific discovery
* Partner with product management, design, and go-to-market to make complex workflows, like modeling and simulation, simple to run with Claude
* Work closely with research to make models better at science and engineering
* Spend time with users in academia and industry to decide what to build next
* Own technical design and delivery end to end, shipping product quickly rather than just executing a spec

**Minimum qualifications**
--------------------------

* Software engineering experience, including owning the technical design and delivery of products
* Experience building products from 0 to 1 in fast-moving environments, and setting technical direction with limited precedent to lean on
* Experience building AI products, and knowledge of what it takes to turn model capabilities into applications people actually use
* Ability to think holistically about user experience and craft tools that are a pleasure for scientists and engineers to use
* Comfort working directly with technical domain experts and customers, and turning what you learn into product
* Enjoyment of solving hard problems together with researchers, scientists, and other engineers

* Background in math, physics, materials science, mechanical or electrical engineering, or another science or engineering field

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.

Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

**Responsibilities:**

JPL’s **Avionics Systems Engineering Group** within the **Avionics, Power, & Instrument Electronics Section** is dedicated to developing avionics subsystem avionics concepts, implementing avionics system architecture designs, designing and ensuring implementation of hardware for flight projects, and supporting project formulation and proposals. We are seeking a creative, experienced **Avionics Systems Engineer III**, with expertise in space hardware development and task leadership, to join the group and participate in developing the next generation of space avionics hardware.

The **Avionics Systems Engineer III** will lead avionics systems engineering tasks within JPL's Avionics Systems Engineering Group. This role carries task-level leadership responsibility, including developing system designs and requirements, and reporting technical progress to Line, Project, and Institutional Management. Candidates should bring several years of systems engineering experience, with a strong preference for prior aerospace or space hardware development.

**Tasks include but are not limited to:**

* Responsible for generation of requirements from the avionics subsystem level through electronic card level, design description and interface documents, engineering change requests, trade studies, model generation and analyses, and verification item generation.
* Develop and execute verification and validation (V&V) plans.
* Will closely collaborate with Cognizant Engineers, Design Engineers and I&T Engineers throughout the product design, I&T and delivery lifecycle.
* Report on technical progress, schedule, and budget to Line, Project, and Institutional Management.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or similar technical discipline with typically a minimum of 6 years of related work experience, a Master’s degree in similar disciplines with typically a minimum of 4 years of related work experience, or a PhD in a similar discipline with typically a minimum of 2 years of related work experience.
* Knowledge of industry and/or academic practices and standards across a range of applications related to the development, testing and integration of electronic assemblies for space applications
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills in relating to both internal and external customers
* Strong ability to multi-task with an established track record of meeting schedules with milestones
* Demonstrated leadership skills and ability to work with a fluctuating, competing, and fast-paced environment
* Ability to obtain and maintain any required U.S. Government security clearance, and be able to work with export-controlled (ITAR) hardware and technical data, which may require U.S. citizenship or lawful permanent residency

* Experience working with Versal ACAP

* Experience specifying, designing, or testing Command and Data Handling modules
* Experience with the use of Jama (or similar) for requirement and verification item management and tracking.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Video SWE
jobs.description:
Meta's Wearables Media Codec and Framework team develops the video encoding and media capture software that powers wearable experiences. We are looking for a Video Codec Software Engineer to build and optimize codec implementations and hardware-accelerated media pipelines for resource-constrained devices like smart glasses.In this role, you will own technical problems from camera capture through encoding, media containers, and audio/video synchronization. You will balance compression efficiency, visual quality, latency, power consumption, thermal limits, and memory usage, working across media frameworks, firmware, and kernel drivers. Partnering with camera, hardware, and silicon teams, you will help define the architecture and technical direction of wearable media systems.  
  
  

### **Software Engineer, Video SWE Responsibilities:**

* Architect, implement, and troubleshoot video codec and media capture pipelines for wearable devices, from camera capture through encoding and media output
* Develop, configure, and tune video encoders, including rate control and compression algorithms, to improve encoding efficiency and visual quality
* Optimize codec performance within device power, thermal, latency, and memory constraints, using profiling and measurement to evaluate trade-offs
* Integrate hardware-accelerated video codecs with mobile and embedded media stacks, working across application processor frameworks, firmware, and kernel drivers
* Develop and improve media container handling, timestamp management, and audio/video synchronization across the capture and encoding pipeline
* Diagnose and resolve video artifacts, synchronization issues, and performance regressions through codec-level and end-to-end system debugging
* Lead technical design and execution for complex media projects, partnering with camera, hardware, and silicon teams to define interfaces, resolve integration challenges, and guide technical roadmaps
* Build and improve automated tests and regression infrastructure for code correctness, visual quality, performance, and power consumption

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or relevant technical field
* 7+ years software development experience in industry settings or PhD with 4+ years of experience
* 3+ years relevant video software engineering experience in industry settings with understanding of multimedia stack, codecs, containers
* Experience in C/C++ multithreaded programming
* Experience in C/C++ multithreaded programming
* Experience leading large or complex projects, defined goals and delivered milestones by leading teams

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with image compression and formats such as JPEG, HEIC/HEIF, or raw/Bayer compression
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience developing automated media regression tests or working with codec tools and libraries such as FFmpeg, libavcodec, x264/x265
* Experience integrating hardware-accelerated video encoding on mobile or low-power systems-on-chip, using media interfaces such as Android MediaCodec, Codec2, OpenMAX, or V4L2
* Knowledge of codec internals, including rate control, motion estimation, intra/inter prediction, rate-distortion optimization, and bitstream analysis
* Experience with media-path firmware or kernel drivers, camera capture integration, or direct collaboration with silicon vendors on hardware-software integration
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience evaluating visual quality using metrics such as PSNR, SSIM, or VMAF, and diagnosing compression artifacts and quality regressions
* Experience with media containers such as MP4/ISOBMFF, muxing and demuxing, timestamp management, and audio/video synchronization
* Experience designing and optimizing media software within power, thermal, latency, and memory bandwidth constraints on wearable, mobile, or embedded devices
* Experience implementing, configuring, or tuning production video encoders using standards such as H.264/AVC, H.265/HEVC, VP9, AV1
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer, Retail & Marcom Engineering
jobs.description:
Summary
  
  
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless. Retail and Marcom Engineering, an IS&T team, builds and operates the systems and experiences that connect Apple's products with its customers. The team owns the technology behind both Apple's online and physical stores and drives the interactive marketing experiences and tools that keep creative operations moving. Together, those functions deliver the technology behind every product story Apple tells and every purchase a customer makes.
  
  
Description
  
  
Financing & Retail Systems team is looking for an experienced Server-side Software Engineer. In this position, you will have the opportunity to partner with our extraordinary team of QA, product and external partners to deliver reliable, seamless experiences for Apple customers & Retail Store employees around the world. As part of the team, you will be joining a hands-on backend development team that cultivates creativity and generates novel, highly scalable, secure & fault tolerant solutions to deliver engineering perfection. You'll work with engineering, QA, product, and carrier partners to solve complex problems, improve service performance and reliability, and troubleshoot issues in production. You'll also contribute to technical design discussions, review code, and help strengthen engineering practices across the team.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* B.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional work experience.
* 5+ years proven experience developing software in a professional capacity. Longer experience preferred.
* 2+ years proven experience with Java, including proficiency in concurrency, memory management, and performance optimization techniques.
* Proficiency in OOP principles, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns (e.g. GoF), with a proven focus on implementing testable, maintainable, and extensible backend code.
* Experience building production applications with the Spring ecosystem (e.g. Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring Data, Spring Cloud, etc.), including proficiency in dependency injection, auto-configuration, reactive programming with WebFlux, and designing microservices using Spring-based patterns.
* Experience in API design and implementation, including proficiency in RESTful API principles, gRPC, GraphQL, contract-first design (e.g. OpenAPI/Swagger, Protobuf, etc.), API versioning strategies, gateway patterns, rate limiting, and designing APIs for backward compatibility and long-term evolution.
* Experience with message-driven and event-driven architectures, including proficiency in messaging systems (e.g. Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, etc.), event sourcing, CQRS patterns, and designing reliable asynchronous communication between distributed services.
* Experience using relational (e.g. Oracle, Postgres, MySQL, etc.) and NoSQL (e.g. Cassandra, MongoDB, etc.) databases, including proficiency in schema design, query optimization, performance tuning (e.g. execution plan analysis, indexing strategy, and query rewriting).

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Track record of leading software projects within a team as a tech lead (TL), while mentoring software engineers.
* Hands-on experience leveraging GenAI coding tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot, Codex) to accelerate the software development lifecycle, enhance code quality, and streamline debugging and testing processes.
* Comfortable using CI/CD tools to build, test, deploy, and release containerized software applications on cloud-based Kubernetes (e.g. AWS EKS, GCP GKE, Azure AKS, etc.).
* Solid knowledge of networking concepts, protocols, and infrastructure (e.g. HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/IP, CDN, load balancing, edge computing, DNS, Zero Trust architecture, etc.).
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization systems, including proficiency in identity protocols (e.g. OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, JWT, etc.), single sign-on (SSO) architectures, role-based and attribute-based access control (RBAC/ABAC), and integration with identity providers and directory services.
* Experience with caching strategies and in-memory data technologies (e.g. Redis, Memcached, Hazelcast, Ehcache, etc.), including proficiency in cache invalidation patterns, distributed caching architectures, and session management for high-throughput applications.

You’ll have the opportunity to grow, innovate, and be a part of an inclusive team that celebrates both individual and collective achievements. If you’re ready to elevate your career and help us deliver exceptional experiences to our customers, apply today and make your mark with Panduit!

**Panduit is seeking a Principal Hardware Design Engineer specializing in Power Electronics to drive the architecture and development of advanced power-conversion technologies**. As part of the Advanced Electronics Engineering team within Research and Advanced Development, you will lead the design of complex AC/DC and DC/DC power systems, including multi-kilowatt power stages, front-end power supplies, uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), and emerging high-voltage DC distribution platforms.

This role offers the opportunity to influence next-generation power-electronics architectures, develop innovative solutions from concept through prototype validation, and solve complex engineering challenges across multiple product platforms. Working alongside cross-functional engineering teams, you will provide technical leadership, independently own critical hardware designs, and help advance technologies that support Panduit's evolving product portfolio.

**What You Will Do**

* Develop and lead **power-electronics architectures** for advanced AC/DC and DC/DC converters, including power factor correction (PFC), isolated converters, resonant topologies, and multi-kilowatt power stages.
* Drive **circuit design and component selection**, including schematics, sensing, protection circuits, gate drives, control interfaces, and power-stage development.
* Perform **simulation and engineering analysis** to evaluate converter performance, control loops, power losses, transient behavior, and overall design optimization.
* Lead **PCB development and design** using Altium Designer or comparable ECAD tools, addressing high-voltage, high-current, and EMI-sensitive design requirements.
* Design and specify **magnetic components**, including transformers and inductors, to support power-conversion performance, efficiency, and reliability.
* Lead **prototype bring-up, troubleshooting, testing, and validation** of complex power-electronics hardware, independently identifying and resolving technical challenges.
* Provide **technical leadership and design ownership** across development programs, driving design reviews, resolving technical risks, and delivering key engineering milestones.
* Collaborate with **cross-functional engineering teams** across firmware, mechanical, test, safety/compliance, manufacturing, product development, and external suppliers to advance designs toward product implementation.

**What You Will Bring**

* **Education**: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline, with 10+ years of relevant hardware development experience, including substantial power-electronics design. A Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or Power Electronics is preferred.
* **Experience**: Extensive experience designing **AC/DC and DC/DC power converters**, including PFC, isolated converters, resonant topologies, and multi-kilowatt power stages.
* Demonstrated ability to independently develop **power-electronics architectures and circuit designs**, including schematics, sensing, protection, gate drives, and control interfaces.
* Proficiency with **power-electronics simulation tools** such as SIMPLIS, LTspice, PSIM, or equivalent, including converter design, control-loop analysis, losses, and transient behavior.
* Experience with **PCB design and ECAD tools**, preferably Altium Designer, including high-voltage, high-current, and EMI-sensitive circuit layouts.
* Strong knowledge of **magnetics design**, including the specification and development of transformers and inductors.
* Demonstrated ability to **independently develop, debug, test, and validate complex hardware**, taking ownership of technical challenges and engineering deliverables.
* Strong technical problem-solving and collaboration skills, with the ability to evaluate complex engineering tradeoffs involving efficiency, power density, cost, safety, reliability, EMI/EMC, and thermal performance.
* Knowledge of **advanced power technologies**, including high-voltage DC distribution, UPS systems, data-center power architectures, SiC/GaN devices, bidirectional converters, high-frequency magnetics, and digital power control.
* Experience with **advanced engineering design practices**, including thermal design, EMI/EMC mitigation, functional safety, regulatory certification, and the development of reusable power-electronics platforms or innovative power-conversion technologies.

**What We Can Offer You**

* **Competitive Pay & Benefits**: Enjoy a robust Total Rewards Program that includes health, financial benefits, and more.
* **Work-Life Balance**: Flexible work options to help you achieve the perfect work-life balance. This role will require you to be in the office 50% of the time (schedule based on manager's discretion).
* **Generous Time Off**: Take advantage of our generous vacation, sick days, holidays, plus a volunteer day to give back to the community.
* **Retirement & Growth**: 401(k) match, profit sharing, and abundant growth and development opportunities to help you advance your career.
* **Parental Leave**: Because we care about your family and your future.

**Compensation**: The expected annual base salary range for this role is $120,000 - $160,000. This role qualifies for an incentive plan based on individual and company performance. Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Compensation is negotiable based upon candidate skills, experience, qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

jobs.title: Robotics Engineer, Autonomous Systems
jobs.description:
### **About the Role**

Join an engineering and R&D team as a Robotics Engineer focused on autonomous systems. You will design, build, integrate, and test drone-based robotic systems from prototype through field validation, supporting safe and reliable delivery operations.

### **What You'll Do**

* Design and integrate robotic mechanisms, sensors, actuators, controllers, and drone payload systems.
* Develop control, navigation, path-planning, and obstacle-avoidance solutions.
* Build robotics software with ROS or ROS 2 and C++ or Python, and validate systems in simulation.
* Integrate flight controllers, companion computers, communication links, and telemetry with drone systems.
* Build, troubleshoot, and independently validate robotic systems in the field.
* Collaborate with mechanical, electronics, and software teams on prototypes and deployments.

### **What We're Looking For**

* At least 2 years of hands-on experience building or delivering robotics, UAV, or autonomous systems.
* Strong fundamentals in kinematics, dynamics, control theory, PID, and system integration.
* Proficiency in C++ or Python, ROS or ROS 2, and Linux; MATLAB familiarity is useful.
* Experience with PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink, flight controllers, motors, ESCs, and batteries.
* Knowledge of IMU, GPS/RTK, LiDAR, sensor fusion, and GPS-denied navigation.
* Embedded systems experience with microcontrollers, Raspberry Pi or Jetson, actuators, and hardware debugging.
* Familiarity with CAN, UART, I2C, drone telemetry, simulation, flight-log analysis, and field testing.
* A degree in robotics, mechatronics, electrical engineering, aerospace, computer science, or a related field.
* Computer vision, machine learning, SLAM, Gazebo or Webots, CAD, or BVLOS experience is a plus.

### **Compensation & Benefits**

Visa sponsorship is not available.

### **Location**

On-site in Indianapolis, United States.

jobs.title: Sr. Interdisciplinary Systems Engineer / Architect, AWS Bespoke Solutions
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Bespoke Solutions group in AWS Region Services is looking for a Interdisciplinary Systems Engineer with technical leadership experience leading hardware, software, and FGPA developers through the systems engineering lifecycle from conception to delivery.
  
  
We develop AWS owned hardware solutions in order to scale globally, minimize cost, and maximize value for our customers. We are a growing team of hardware, software and FPGA engineers with a dedicated product development lab in Arlington, VA.  
  
You will perform system/product definition, requirements decomposition, technical risk assessments, and end to end testing for scalable high assurance embedded systems in the AWS technology ecosystem.  
  
As a member of the Bespoke Solutions Team in Region Services, you will be joining a talented full-stack development team (hardware and software) that is laser-focused on developing network security products that enable our Amazon Dedicated Cloud to operate efficiently at scale.  
  
This position requires that the candidate selected must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance. The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph or commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Evaluate, develop, and deliver solutions for the lifecycle of complex interdisciplinary system design problems for which the technical strategy is frequently not defined
* Derive requirements for system efficiency, operational excellence, and user experience.
* Lead design and system engineers to perform verification and validation of certification requirements.
* Generate technical artifacts that ensure design completeness and improve system traceability.
* Lead design meetings to plan development and review peer designs.
* Test/verify new technologies to improve the customer experience.
* Mentor and educate other engineers on systems goals and constraints in relation to physical, interfaces, compliance, data management, and risk management.

  
A day in the life  
You will be a technical leader on a cross-functional team of hardware and software developers, focusing on system-level integration and verification. You will help set and maintain the standard for system testing and verification, understanding and planning for the impact of team decisions on overall system architecture in team meetings, design reviews, and through written documents. You will lead architectural discussions, and strategic planning meetings.  
  
You will use and develop CI/CD pipelines to automatically run your own unit tests, and hardware in the loop tests. You help deploy embedded software onto hardware targets and help debug issues that come along in RTL, hardware, or software. You will develop and document software sub-systems and components in Rust, you will coordinate with the team daily to make design decisions, resolve blockers, and review code.  
  
You will guide system architecture development and trade studies for encryption devices, key management systems, FPGAs, and ASICs. You will generate artifacts for design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR) as part of the government certification processes. You will work with various teams to establish requirements, develop verification methods, and ensure system specifications are met. You will use tools such as Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) or Systems Modeling Language (SysML) to create and maintain system documentation, including test procedures, requirements documentation, and verification matrices.
  
  
You will demonstrate a high standard, help prioritize development activities and educate others about systems engineering best practices and tools.  
  
About the team  
About AWS
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Why AWS?  
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.  
  
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)  
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
Diverse Experiences  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

jobs.title: Controls Engineer 2
jobs.description:
Company Overview: Hamilton Medical was founded in 1983 with a clear mission: to enhance the lives of patients on respirators and support the caregivers who serve them. Our focus is on developing ventilation technologies that prioritize safety, effectiveness, and lung protection. We are dedicated to easing the burden on healthcare professionals who work tirelessly every day, helping critically ill patients recover and regain their health. We are committed to helping medical teams deliver the best respiratory care ‑ to anyone, anywhere. Responsibilities:

Hamilton Medical, Inc. (HMI) is seeking a Controls Engineer 2 who will take technical ownership of the control systems for all automated equipment at HMI. This role maintains and improves PLC, HMI, and robot programs to increase equipment reliability, process yield, and production efficiency. The Controls Engineer 2 works with Manufacturing Engineering to optimize automation, supports Maintenance in troubleshooting equipment errors, and coordinates technical activities with external automation vendors. The role independently executes assigned controls work with occasional guidance on complex issues. A strong candidate solves problems efficiently, creates practical solutions, documents changes, shares knowledge, and supports safe, consistent production.

**Essential Job Functions:**

* Takes technical ownership of control systems for all automated equipment at HMI, maintaining reliable operation and serving as the primary internal controls resource.
* Develops, modifies, tests, and maintains PLC and HMI programs, including machine sequences, alarms, diagnostics, recipes, and process settings.
* Programs, debugs, and optimizes robots, including motion paths, tooling interfaces, equipment handshakes, and fault recovery sequences.
* Integrates and troubleshoots sensors, actuators, servo drives, machine vision, and other peripheral devices through PLC interfaces and industrial communication networks.
* Partners with manufacturing engineers to analyze cycle time, downtime, faults, and yield, and implements controls improvements that increase automation performance and process consistency to attain target OEE KPIs.
* Supports Maintenance in troubleshooting control system errors and restoring equipment operation, and investigates recurring failures and implements corrective actions with Engineering and Quality.
* Coordinates external automation vendors for troubleshooting, modifications, and upgrades, reviews technical deliverables and obtains current source programs, backups, and documentation for HMI support.
* Translates manufacturing needs into controls requirements and functional specifications, reviews proposed hardware, software, and vendor designs for maintainability and compatibility with HMI equipment.
* Coordinates controls startup, debugging, and commissioning for new and modified equipment, supports factory acceptance testing, site acceptance testing, and production handoff.
* Applies and improves programming standards, reusable code, and documentation practices, maintains controlled program versions, verified backups, change histories, and recovery instructions.
* Develops and executes controls test plans, including affected functions and fault recovery, supports equipment qualification and validation with Manufacturing Engineering and Quality.
* Assesses controls changes for effects on machine safety, product quality, and validated processes, follows HMI change control, testing, and release requirements.
* Maintains electrical schematics, I/O lists, network layouts, program comments, and troubleshooting guides, supports equipment data collection for diagnostics and performance analysis.
* Trains Maintenance, Manufacturing Engineering, and production personnel on controls, diagnostics, and recovery procedures appropriate to their roles.
* Plans assigned controls projects and upgrades, including obsolete component replacement, estimates resources, communicates schedules and risks, and coordinates downtime with Production and Maintenance.
* Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

* Independently uses first-principles thinking and structured troubleshooting, seeks assistance when technical complexity or risk requires additional expertise.
* Shows initiative, takes ownership of assigned tasks, and completes work without repeated prompting.
* Proficient in PLC programming and troubleshooting, HMI development, and robot programming for automated manufacturing equipment.
* Working knowledge of sensors, actuators, servo systems, variable frequency drives, machine vision interfaces, and industrial communication networks.
* Ability to read electrical schematics and use diagnostic tools to distinguish programming, electrical, mechanical, and process-related faults.
* Ability to evaluate equipment performance data and apply root cause analysis techniques to recurring faults and production losses.
* Working knowledge of machine safety functions, interlocks, and safe troubleshooting practices, follows established equipment safety procedures.
* Excellent communication and documentation skills, works effectively with manufacturing engineers, maintenance technicians, production personnel, Quality, and external vendors.
* Ability to prioritize competing production needs, communicate realistic completion dates, and support planned installations and production recovery activities.

Education/Experience:

* 3+ years of technical experience in controls engineering or industrial automation, including hands-on PLC programming and troubleshooting.
* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechatronics, or a closely related engineering discipline required.
* Experience programming and supporting industrial robots in manufacturing applications required.
* Experience with PLC and HMI platforms such as Allen-Bradley, Siemens, Beckhoff, or comparable systems, ability to learn and support multiple platforms.

This position provides an opportunity to work across multiple engineering disciplines while contributing to the development and support of complex technical systems. The successful candidate will collaborate with experienced engineers and technical specialists to solve engineering problems, evaluate product performance, and support ongoing development projects.

As part of the onboarding and training process, the employee will participate in a structured cross-functional rotation through Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Hardware Engineering, and Sales/Technical Support. Each rotation will last approximately two months and provide hands-on experience with the products, processes, and technical responsibilities of each department.

Following the initial training period, the employee will continue in their Systems Engineering role, applying the knowledge gained across disciplines to support engineering projects and product development activities.

The following duties are representative of the position and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities.

Summary
  
  
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced machine learning engineer to join AIML Evaluation to build the systems that evaluate and refine Apple's foundation models and agents. As a key member of the team, you will help design and develop benchmarks, evaluators, simulation environments, and prompt and context optimization pipelines that drive quality improvements across Apple's AI experiences. You will collaborate with product teams and the foundation model team to close the loop between observation and improvement, contributing datasets, environments, and reward signals that drive model and agent quality.
  
  
Description
  
  
Most model evaluation stops at a scorecard. The failing traces get thrown away, even though they're the most relevant training signal we have. Our team puts them to work. We evaluate across offline benchmarks, device-in-the-loop simulation, and on-device observation in production, and we turn what we find into persona-grounded datasets and reward signals for foundation model post-training. In this role, you will build the systems that connect failure analysis to measurable model and agent improvements across a broad range of AI products at Apple. The path from finding a problem to fixing it is short: the loop you build finds the failure, produces the data and checks the result. The work reaches millions of users.

**Job Description Summary**
===========================

Join GE HealthCare's CT Engineering team and help define how electrical power is designed, distributed and managed across our next generation of CT systems.  
  
We're looking for an experienced Power Electronics Engineer who enjoys solving complex system-level problems and wants to stay actively involved in the engineering work. This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not an oversight position. You'll help set the architecture and technical direction while also designing, analyzing, troubleshooting, testing, and solving problems alongside the team.  
  
In this role, you'll work across multiple circuit boards and electrical subsystems to help define the overall power architecture of our CT platforms. You'll influence long-term technical strategy while continuing to design, analyze, prototype, troubleshoot and test real hardware.  
  
This is an exciting opportunity for someone who has built deep expertise in power electronics and is ready to expand their influence from individual circuit and board design into broader system architecture and technical leadership.  
  
Location: Waukesha, Wisconsin, hybrid with approximately 3 days onsite  
  
Relocation assistance: Available

**Job Description**
===================

### **What You'll Do**

* Define and evolve electrical power architecture for advanced CT systems.
* Design analog and power electronics circuitry, including power conversion, controls and high-speed interfaces.
* Develop electrical architectures spanning multiple boards, components and subsystems.
* Create and review schematics and PCB designs using ECAD tools.
* Lead technical design reviews and promote strong engineering rigor and best practices.
* Build and evaluate prototypes and conduct hands-on troubleshooting, validation and reliability testing.
* Take designs from concept through prototype, verification and production support.
* Partner with digital, systems, mechanical, manufacturing, service and global engineering teams to solve complex design challenges.
* Balance performance, reliability, manufacturability, cost and regulatory requirements when making design decisions.
* Help shape longer-term power electronics strategy for future CT platforms.

### **What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering.
* 7+ years of professional electrical engineering experience.
* Strong hands-on experience with **power electronics and power conversion**.
* Experience designing and analyzing electrical circuits, including schematic design and simulation.
* Experience with PCB design/layout and schematic capture.
* Experience taking electrical designs from concept through prototype, testing and production support.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly across engineering teams.

### **We'd Love to See**

Experience in one or more of the following is helpful, but **you don't need to check every box**:

* Switching power supplies, converters or power distribution systems.
* Buck/boost or resonant converter design.
* High-power or higher-voltage electrical systems.
* EMC-conscious design and troubleshooting.
* Design for reliability and manufacturability.
* UL, ETL, IEC or other applicable regulatory standards.

### **Why This Role?**

**This is a working architect role, not an oversight role.** You'll help set the power architecture strategy for our CT platforms while remaining actively involved in the engineering. You'll work directly with schematics, circuits, PCBs, prototypes, testing, troubleshooting, and design reviews while also providing technical direction across the broader system.

It's a great opportunity for an experienced power electronics engineer who wants to **stay close to the technology while growing their influence from board-level design into system-level architecture and technical leadership.**

This isn't an architecture role where you'll step away from engineering.

You'll have the opportunity to **stay hands-on while expanding your technical influence**, helping determine how power moves through an incredibly complex medical imaging system.

You'll work with a large multidisciplinary engineering organization, collaborate globally, solve difficult technical problems and help set the direction for future CT platforms.

For an experienced power electronics engineer who's ready to grow from **board-level design into system-level technical leadership**, this role offers a very natural next step.
