new_jobs.title: Systems Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**ABOUT MIND:**
---------------

Mind Robotics is building Physical AI for real-world industrial deployment, starting with the factory floor. We believe the hardest problems in AI are solved when researchers and engineers are hands-on with the physical world every day - and we're looking for people who are passionate about robotics, value ownership, and are excited to tackle difficult problems. Join us if you want to move beyond digital intelligence and put intelligence into motion.

**THE ROLE:**
-------------

At Mind Robotics, we're building generalized physical AI — robotic systems capable of dexterous, adaptive, reasoning-intensive and most importantly safe work in real-world industrial environments. Systems engineering is the discipline that holds it all together: translating mission requirements into hardware reality and ensuring every subsystem behaves as a coherent whole.

We're looking for a Systems Engineer to own the requirements and architecture baseline for the robot — from decomposing high-level behaviors into measurable, traceable specs, to making sure the system and its safety requirements hold together from concept through field deployment. You'll define how the robot is supposed to behave, how we prove it, and what "ready to ship" means, working alongside software, mechanical, electrical, and integration teams.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**
---------------------

* Own the system requirements baseline: capture top-level robot behaviors and performance targets, and decompose them into measurable subsystem requirements, budgets, and interfaces, with traceability through to verification
* Define software requirements from high-level system requirements, using first-principles analysis and hardware/model-based testing
* Contribute to architectural decisions for new robot subsystems — communication protocols, control strategies, and hardware-software partitioning — alongside firmware/controls, mechanical, and electrical teams
* Own interface definitions across mechanical, electrical, firmware, controls, and software, and manage requirement and interface changes and their cross-subsystem impact
* Lead system-level failure mode and hazard analysis (DFMEA, HARA, FTA) together with subsystem owners, and derive, allocate, and trace the resulting safety requirements to subsystems and their verification
* Work cross-functionally to drive the verification and validation strategy: system-level test plans from bench testing through field deployment, acceptance criteria, and requirements coverage
* Work cross-functionally with subsystem owners to drive requirements and system-level coverage for on-robot diagnostics, telemetry, and health monitoring that support field deployment and service
* Drive readiness reviews, sign-off, and post-launch monitoring across firmware, hardware, controls, reliability, and manufacturing stakeholders
* Work with integration engineers to turn bench and field findings into requirement, interface, and design changes

**REQUIREMENTS:**
-----------------

* Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Robotics, or equivalent experience
* 5+ years in systems engineering on complex electromechanical, robotic, or autonomous products, including at least one product taken through to field deployment
* Demonstrated experience writing, decomposing, and managing requirements — making high-level system behaviors measurable and testable, with traceability from requirement to design to verification
* Hands-on experience with hazard and risk analysis (DFMEA/FMEDA, HARA, FTA) and turning the results into requirements and test cases
* Working knowledge of functional safety standards and concepts (IEC 61508, ISO 13849, IEC 62061, ISO 26262, or similar)
* Strong hardware and software fundamentals — able to bridge electrical schematics, embedded communication protocols, and firmware architecture, and to debug system-level issues alongside integration and firmware engineers
* Proficient in data analysis and scripting — able to use hardware and field data to validate or challenge requirements
* Clear written and verbal communication — specs that mechanical, electrical, and firmware teams can all build and test against
* You are comfortable with ambiguity, move fast, and have an "engineering curiosity" that drives you to understand how the entire system works, not just your part

**NICE TO HAVE:**
-----------------

* Experience with requirements management tools (Jama, Polarion, DOORS, etc.) or model-based systems engineering (SysML)
* Experience supporting product safety certification (NRTL or notified body) as a technical contributor
* Experience specifying or validating systems that include learned/ML-based components
* Background in robotics, EV powertrains, drones, aerospace, or other dense electromechanical systems
* Exposure to manufacturing self-test design or service diagnostics

new_jobs.description:
**About Subsense**
------------------

Subsense is a deep-tech company developing the world’s first non-surgical, bidirectional brain-computer interface powered by plasmonic and magnetoelectric nanoparticles. Our mission is to unlock direct communication between the human brain and AI - starting with medical applications such as stroke recovery and moving toward cognitive enhancement for healthy users. Headquartered in Palo Alto, Subsense brings together leading scientists and engineers to redefine the future of human–machine interaction.

### **The Opportunity**

Design, develop, and integrate electronics and hardware for emerging neurotechnology, biotechnology, and medical-device systems. You will contribute to the development of experimental platforms, proof-of-concept devices, data acquisition systems, and integrated hardware supporting a range of research and development activities. Projects may involve electronics for optical, magnetic, sensing, and other biomedical technologies as technical needs evolve.

This role offers an opportunity for an early-career engineer to gain hands-on experience across electrical engineering, biomedical instrumentation, and multidisciplinary system development. You will work on hardware from initial concepts and circuit designs through prototyping, integration, characterization, and testing, with opportunities to independently develop electrical subsystems and experimental solutions.

Working closely with specialists in engineering, neuroscience, biology, and software, you will help translate experimental requirements into functional hardware systems. The ideal candidate is curious, enjoys building and troubleshooting physical systems, and has a strong interest in applying engineering principles to biotechnology, biomedical research, and neurotechnology.

Meta's Wearables Media Codec and Framework team develops the video encoding and media capture software that powers wearable experiences. We are looking for a Video Codec Software Engineer to build and optimize codec implementations and hardware-accelerated media pipelines for resource-constrained devices like smart glasses.In this role, you will own technical problems from camera capture through encoding, media containers, and audio/video synchronization. You will balance compression efficiency, visual quality, latency, power consumption, thermal limits, and memory usage, working across media frameworks, firmware, and kernel drivers. Partnering with camera, hardware, and silicon teams, you will help define the architecture and technical direction of wearable media systems.  
  
  

### **Software Engineer, Video SWE Responsibilities:**

* Architect, implement, and troubleshoot video codec and media capture pipelines for wearable devices, from camera capture through encoding and media output
* Develop, configure, and tune video encoders, including rate control and compression algorithms, to improve encoding efficiency and visual quality
* Optimize codec performance within device power, thermal, latency, and memory constraints, using profiling and measurement to evaluate trade-offs
* Integrate hardware-accelerated video codecs with mobile and embedded media stacks, working across application processor frameworks, firmware, and kernel drivers
* Develop and improve media container handling, timestamp management, and audio/video synchronization across the capture and encoding pipeline
* Diagnose and resolve video artifacts, synchronization issues, and performance regressions through codec-level and end-to-end system debugging
* Lead technical design and execution for complex media projects, partnering with camera, hardware, and silicon teams to define interfaces, resolve integration challenges, and guide technical roadmaps
* Build and improve automated tests and regression infrastructure for code correctness, visual quality, performance, and power consumption

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or relevant technical field
* 7+ years software development experience in industry settings or PhD with 4+ years of experience
* 3+ years relevant video software engineering experience in industry settings with understanding of multimedia stack, codecs, containers
* Experience in C/C++ multithreaded programming
* Experience in C/C++ multithreaded programming
* Experience leading large or complex projects, defined goals and delivered milestones by leading teams

* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience developing automated media regression tests or working with codec tools and libraries such as FFmpeg, libavcodec, x264/x265
* Experience integrating hardware-accelerated video encoding on mobile or low-power systems-on-chip, using media interfaces such as Android MediaCodec, Codec2, OpenMAX, or V4L2
* Knowledge of codec internals, including rate control, motion estimation, intra/inter prediction, rate-distortion optimization, and bitstream analysis
* Experience with media-path firmware or kernel drivers, camera capture integration, or direct collaboration with silicon vendors on hardware-software integration
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience evaluating visual quality using metrics such as PSNR, SSIM, or VMAF, and diagnosing compression artifacts and quality regressions
* Experience with media containers such as MP4/ISOBMFF, muxing and demuxing, timestamp management, and audio/video synchronization
* Experience designing and optimizing media software within power, thermal, latency, and memory bandwidth constraints on wearable, mobile, or embedded devices
* Experience implementing, configuring, or tuning production video encoders using standards such as H.264/AVC, H.265/HEVC, VP9, AV1
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

new_jobs.title: Staff Embedded Software Engineer - 5G Devices & NTN Connectivity
new_jobs.description:
About us:

At Viasat, the work you do helps people stay connected in ways that matter, from everyday moments to critical missions across air, land, sea, and space.

We’re a place for people who are curious, bold, and motivated by meaningful work. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, explore new possibilities, and grow your career in ways that align with your interests and goals. When you're ready to take on something new, you'll find leaders who support your development and help you turn your ambition into action.

What you'll do:

At Viasat, we're building the next generation of global connectivity by seamlessly integrating terrestrial 5G networks with advanced satellite communications. Our Access Edge Terminal Software team develops the embedded software that powers innovative connectivity solutions across aviation, maritime, residential, automotive, and emerging mobility markets.

We are seeking a **Staff Embedded Software Engineers - 5G Devices & NTN Connectivity** to architect and develop software platforms for 5G User Equipment (UE) and Customer Premises Equipment (CPE). In this role, you will combine industry-leading 5G technologies with Viasat's satellite capabilities to create hybrid connectivity solutions that deliver reliable communications wherever customers operate.

This is a highly impactful engineering position focused on device-side software architecture, embedded Linux development, modem integration, and platform design. You will work closely with chipset vendors, hardware teams, and product stakeholders to define and deliver next-generation connected devices.

**Note:** This position focuses on device/UE software architecture and development and is distinct from RAN (gNodeB/base station) or 5G Core network roles. Candidates should have experience with device-side, client-side, or CPE software development rather than network infrastructure technologies.

The day-to-day:

**Software Architecture & Platform Development**

* Design and implement modular software architectures with reusable building blocks for devices operating on Viasat's satellite and NTN networks.
* Develop hardware abstraction layers (HALs), middleware, and platform services that decouple application software from modem and hardware implementations.
* Create scalable software frameworks that support multiple device variants, deployment models, and market-specific requirements.
* Define robust APIs and interfaces that enable independent development, testing, and lifecycle management of software components.
* Balance architectural flexibility, maintainability, and performance in resource-constrained embedded environments.

**5G Modem Integration & Embedded Development**

* Integrate 5G modem solutions from industry-leading vendors such as Qualcomm, MediaTek, Intel, and other ecosystem partners.
* Develop and maintain Linux kernel drivers supporting modem interfaces including PCIe, USB, SDIO, and UART.
* Implement software responsible for modem initialization, configuration, power management, diagnostics, and runtime operation.
* Customize vendor Board Support Packages (BSPs) to meet Viasat hardware and product requirements.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex hardware-software integration challenges.
* Optimize system performance for latency, throughput, power efficiency, reliability, and stability.

**Reference Architectures & Partner Enablement**

* Design and maintain reference software architectures used by OEM and ODM partners.
* Create SDKs that include software libraries, sample applications, documentation, and development tools.
* Develop "golden reference" implementations demonstrating best practices for building 5G NTN-enabled devices compatible with Viasat networks.
* Provide technical guidance and support to external development partners.
* Ensure reference platforms align with industry standards and evolving ecosystem requirements.
* Balance platform standardization with flexibility to support diverse partner and market needs.

**System Integration & Validation**

* Collaborate with hardware and systems engineering teams to define device architectures and software-hardware interfaces.
* Develop automated test frameworks and validation solutions for software platform verification.
* Perform software profiling, performance analysis, and end-to-end optimization.
* Support field trials, customer deployments, and production issue resolution activities.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Partner with chipset vendor field application engineers (FAEs) and technical specialists to resolve complex integration challenges.
* Collaborate with product management to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Work closely with application development teams to ensure platform capabilities support future product needs.
* Mentor engineers on embedded systems, 5G device technologies, Linux development, and software engineering best practices.

What you'll need:

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 8+ years of experience developing embedded software for wireless communication devices.
* Proven track record delivering commercial 5G UE or CPE products.
* Familiarity with 5G device architecture, including RF, baseband, and application processor subsystems.
* Hands-on experience integrating 5G modem chipsets from vendors such as Qualcomm, MediaTek, Intel, or Samsung.
* Knowledge of 3GPP UE protocol stacks including NAS, SDAP, RRC, PDCP, RLC, MAC, and PHY layers from a device perspective.
* Familiarity with 5G NR procedures, MIMO technologies, carrier aggregation, and device performance optimization.
* Familiarity with regulatory and certification requirements including FCC, CE, and carrier approvals.

**Software & Systems Expertise**

* Proficiency in C/C++ for embedded and system-level programming.
* Strong experience with Linux kernel

At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

Boeing Defense, Space & Security (BDS) Space, Intelligence & Weapons Systems (SI&WS) Organization is seeking a **Gigabit Ethernet Data Multiplex System (GEDMS) Communications & Network Systems Engineer** to support System Network Architecting and Application Engineering activities in **Huntington Beach, CA**.

The GEDMS program, led out of Huntington Beach, CA, consists of geographically distributed team members. Locations include the east coast and shipbuilding facilities in Bath, ME as well as Pascagoula, MS. The GEDMS team is responsible for the design and sustainment of a family of ship-wide network system variants that include equipment for ruggedized switching, routing, and message/signal processing. The system is designed for use on both United States (US) Navy and foreign ships.

The candidate will be instrumental in performing and managing high visibility tasks assigned by the US Navy customer for the System Engineering effort (network design and architecture development, requirements derivation, use cases, functional analysis, specifications development, verification and validation, etc.) required to develop and evolve the next-generation secure GEDMS architectures. The selected candidate will be responsible for providing Systems Engineering support for major shipboard design variants. In addition, responsibilities will include coordinating ongoing activities with internal and external team members and communicating with the customer.

Our teams are currently hiring for a broad range of experience levels including Experienced or Lead Level Engineers.

**Position Responsibilities:**

new_jobs.title: Principal Robotic Controls Engineer
new_jobs.description:
### **About the Role**

Join a defense technology team developing autonomous directed-energy systems. As the senior technical anchor for controls, you will shape precision pointing and tracking architecture, from theory and simulation through real-world hardware testing.

### **What You'll Do**

* Design control architecture for coarse gimbals and fine steering mirrors, including bandwidth allocation, multi-rate operation, and stage handoffs.
* Develop Kalman, interacting multiple model, and nonlinear filters that fuse radar, EO/IR, and inertial data into latency-compensated aimpoint estimates.
* Build line-of-sight stabilization and jitter-rejection methods, including inertial stabilization, feedforward, and adaptive or notch filtering for structural modes.
* Allocate pointing error budgets across jitter, bias, latency, and atmospheric effects, then validate precision performance against dynamic targets in field tests.
* Model plants and identify system dynamics for gimbals, mirrors, and structures, using simulation and hardware-in-the-loop validation.
* Analyze stability and robustness under disturbances and parameter variation, and integrate controls with tracking, engagement sequencing, and safety logic.
* Deploy control algorithms to embedded targets, collaborate on kilohertz-rate loops, and compare field test results with simulation predictions.
* Provide technical review across controls and sensor integration, and mentor engineers through hands-on technical leadership.

### **What We're Looking For**

* At least 10 years of experience closing loops on precision pointing, tracking, or stabilization hardware, with PhD-level depth in control theory and estimation.
* Proficiency in robust control, including H-infinity, mu-synthesis, and LQG, plus optimal estimation such as Kalman variants, IMM, and nonlinear observers.
* Experience shipping C or C++ control loops on embedded or RTOS targets, and working with MATLAB/Simulink and Python.
* Background in sensor fusion, multi-rate and sampled-data design, real-time hardware-in-the-loop validation, system identification, and structural dynamics.
* Ability to serve as the controls technical anchor on a small team. Directed-energy or high-energy laser experience and an active security clearance, or ability to obtain one, are advantages.

### **Compensation & Benefits**

Base salary range: $250,000 to $315,000 annually. Equity and visa sponsorship details were not provided.

### **Location**

On-site in San Francisco, United States.

**Overview**

Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft’s expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft’s “Intelligent Cloud” mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Teams, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for engineers to help achieve that mission.

The Methodology, Infrastructure, Silicon Engineering, and Labs engineering (MILE) team delivers the physical design CAD flows, tools, and infrastructure that Microsoft’s silicon design teams use to take advanced-node chips from RTL to tapeout. Within MILE, the Physical Design (PD) CAD signoff group owns logic signoff, including formal equivalency checking, ECO verification, and low-power verification. Our flows are how design teams prove their silicon is functionally correct before tapeout, so quality here directly protects schedule, cost, and silicon quality across Microsoft’s cloud and AI programs.

We are looking for a Senior PD CAD Equivalency Engineer to own and evolve our formal equivalency flows, working with design teams and EDA vendors to deliver reliable, high-quality equivalency checking for Microsoft’s next-generation silicon.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Own the end-to-end formal equivalency CAD flow, including RTL-to-netlist, netlist-to-netlist, functional ECO, and low-power (UPF-aware) verification, for Microsoft’s silicon programs
* Develop, debug, and maintain production flows and automation in Tcl and Python for Synopsys Formality and Cadence Conformal, including handling of complex design classes
* Partner with physical design, front-end/synthesis, and signoff teams and with EDA vendors (Synopsys, Cadence) to qualify new tool releases, resolve critical tool issues, and support design teams through tapeout closure
* Independently drive technical decisions for the equivalency domain, identify root causes of ambiguous tool behavior, and define clear paths to resolution; mentor and serve as a backup for other engineers in the team

new_jobs.description:
Meta's Wearables Media Codec and Framework team develops the video encoding and media capture software that powers wearable experiences. We are looking for a Video Codec Software Engineer to build and optimize codec implementations and hardware-accelerated media pipelines for resource-constrained devices like smart glasses.In this role, you will own technical problems from camera capture through encoding, media containers, and audio/video synchronization. You will balance compression efficiency, visual quality, latency, power consumption, thermal limits, and memory usage, working across media frameworks, firmware, and kernel drivers. Partnering with camera, hardware, and silicon teams, you will help define the architecture and technical direction of wearable media systems.  
  
  

### **Software Engineer, Video SWE Responsibilities:**

* Architect, implement, and troubleshoot video codec and media capture pipelines for wearable devices, from camera capture through encoding and media output
* Develop, configure, and tune video encoders, including rate control and compression algorithms, to improve encoding efficiency and visual quality
* Optimize codec performance within device power, thermal, latency, and memory constraints, using profiling and measurement to evaluate trade-offs
* Integrate hardware-accelerated video codecs with mobile and embedded media stacks, working across application processor frameworks, firmware, and kernel drivers
* Develop and improve media container handling, timestamp management, and audio/video synchronization across the capture and encoding pipeline
* Diagnose and resolve video artifacts, synchronization issues, and performance regressions through codec-level and end-to-end system debugging
* Lead technical design and execution for complex media projects, partnering with camera, hardware, and silicon teams to define interfaces, resolve integration challenges, and guide technical roadmaps
* Build and improve automated tests and regression infrastructure for code correctness, visual quality, performance, and power consumption

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or relevant technical field
* 7+ years software development experience in industry settings or PhD with 4+ years of experience
* 3+ years relevant video software engineering experience in industry settings with understanding of multimedia stack, codecs, containers
* Experience in C/C++ multithreaded programming
* Experience in C/C++ multithreaded programming
* Experience leading large or complex projects, defined goals and delivered milestones by leading teams

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with image compression and formats such as JPEG, HEIC/HEIF, or raw/Bayer compression
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience developing automated media regression tests or working with codec tools and libraries such as FFmpeg, libavcodec, x264/x265
* Experience integrating hardware-accelerated video encoding on mobile or low-power systems-on-chip, using media interfaces such as Android MediaCodec, Codec2, OpenMAX, or V4L2
* Knowledge of codec internals, including rate control, motion estimation, intra/inter prediction, rate-distortion optimization, and bitstream analysis
* Experience with media-path firmware or kernel drivers, camera capture integration, or direct collaboration with silicon vendors on hardware-software integration
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience evaluating visual quality using metrics such as PSNR, SSIM, or VMAF, and diagnosing compression artifacts and quality regressions
* Experience with media containers such as MP4/ISOBMFF, muxing and demuxing, timestamp management, and audio/video synchronization
* Experience designing and optimizing media software within power, thermal, latency, and memory bandwidth constraints on wearable, mobile, or embedded devices
* Experience implementing, configuring, or tuning production video encoders using standards such as H.264/AVC, H.265/HEVC, VP9, AV1
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. new_jobs.description:
Summary
  
  
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless. Retail and Marcom Engineering, an IS&T team, builds and operates the systems and experiences that connect Apple's products with its customers. The team owns the technology behind both Apple's online and physical stores and drives the interactive marketing experiences and tools that keep creative operations moving. Together, those functions deliver the technology behind every product story Apple tells and every purchase a customer makes.
  
  
Description
  
  
Financing & Retail Systems team is looking for an experienced Server-side Software Engineer. In this position, you will have the opportunity to partner with our extraordinary team of QA, product and external partners to deliver reliable, seamless experiences for Apple customers & Retail Store employees around the world. As part of the team, you will be joining a hands-on backend development team that cultivates creativity and generates novel, highly scalable, secure & fault tolerant solutions to deliver engineering perfection. * B.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional work experience.
* 5+ years proven experience developing software in a professional capacity. Longer experience preferred.

* Proficiency in OOP principles, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns (e.g. GoF), with a proven focus on implementing testable, maintainable, and extensible backend code.
* Experience building production applications with the Spring ecosystem (e.g. Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring Data, Spring Cloud, etc.), including proficiency in dependency injection, auto-configuration, reactive programming with WebFlux, and designing microservices using Spring-based patterns.

* Experience with message-driven and event-driven architectures, including proficiency in messaging systems (e.g. Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, etc.), event sourcing, CQRS patterns, and designing reliable asynchronous communication between distributed services.
* Experience using relational (e.g. Oracle, Postgres, MySQL, etc.) and NoSQL (e.g. Cassandra, MongoDB, etc.) databases, including proficiency in schema design, query optimization, performance tuning (e.g. execution plan analysis, indexing strategy, and query rewriting).

* Track record of leading software projects within a team as a tech lead (TL), while mentoring software engineers.
* Hands-on experience leveraging GenAI coding tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot, Codex) to accelerate the software development lifecycle, enhance code quality, and streamline debugging and testing processes.
* Comfortable using CI/CD tools to build, test, deploy, and release containerized software applications on cloud-based Kubernetes (e.g. AWS EKS, GCP GKE, Azure AKS, etc.).
* Solid knowledge of networking concepts, protocols, and infrastructure (e.g. HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/IP, CDN, load balancing, edge computing, DNS, Zero Trust architecture, etc.).

---------------

The Bespoke Solutions group in AWS Region Services is looking for a Interdisciplinary Systems Engineer with technical leadership experience leading hardware, software, and FGPA developers through the systems engineering lifecycle from conception to delivery.
  
  
We develop AWS owned hardware solutions in order to scale globally, minimize cost, and maximize value for our customers. We are a growing team of hardware, software and FPGA engineers with a dedicated product development lab in Arlington, VA.  
  
You will perform system/product definition, requirements decomposition, technical risk assessments, and end to end testing for scalable high assurance embedded systems in the AWS technology ecosystem.  
  
As a member of the Bespoke Solutions Team in Region Services, you will be joining a talented full-stack development team (hardware and software) that is laser-focused on developing network security products that enable our Amazon Dedicated Cloud to operate efficiently at scale.  
  
This position requires that the candidate selected must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance. The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph or commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Evaluate, develop, and deliver solutions for the lifecycle of complex interdisciplinary system design problems for which the technical strategy is frequently not defined
* Derive requirements for system efficiency, operational excellence, and user experience.
* Lead design and system engineers to perform verification and validation of certification requirements.
* Generate technical artifacts that ensure design completeness and improve system traceability.
* Lead design meetings to plan development and review peer designs.
* Test/verify new technologies to improve the customer experience.
* Mentor and educate other engineers on systems goals and constraints in relation to physical, interfaces, compliance, data management, and risk management.

  
A day in the life  
You will be a technical leader on a cross-functional team of hardware and software developers, focusing on system-level integration and verification. You will help set and maintain the standard for system testing and verification, understanding and planning for the impact of team decisions on overall system architecture in team meetings, design reviews, and through written documents. You will lead architectural discussions, and strategic planning meetings.  
  
You will use and develop CI/CD pipelines to automatically run your own unit tests, and hardware in the loop tests. You help deploy embedded software onto hardware targets and help debug issues that come along in RTL, hardware, or software. You will develop and document software sub-systems and components in Rust, you will coordinate with the team daily to make design decisions, resolve blockers, and review code.  
  
You will guide system architecture development and trade studies for encryption devices, key management systems, FPGAs, and ASICs. You will generate artifacts for design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR) as part of the government certification processes. You will work with various teams to establish requirements, develop verification methods, and ensure system specifications are met. You will use tools such as Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) or Systems Modeling Language (SysML) to create and maintain system documentation, including test procedures, requirements documentation, and verification matrices.
  
  
You will demonstrate a high standard, help prioritize development activities and educate others about systems engineering best practices and tools.

WISER Systems, Inc. is a Raleigh-based technology company specializing in real-time location systems (RTLS), ultra-wideband (UWB) technology, and industrial asset-tracking solutions. The company develops integrated hardware and software platforms that help manufacturers track equipment, tools, work-in-progress materials, and other valuable assets. Its technology supports industries including aerospace, automotive, electronics, biomedical manufacturing, and defense.

Job Overview

WISER Systems is seeking a skilled Software Systems Engineer to contribute to the development, integration, and maintenance of software systems supporting real-time location and industrial tracking technologies.

The ideal candidate will have experience in software engineering, backend development, system architecture, and software integration. This role involves developing reliable software components, processing real-time data, and improving communication between connected devices and enterprise applications.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and maintain software systems and application components.
* Develop backend services for real-time data processing and asset tracking.
* Build and maintain APIs for software and hardware integrations.
* Support communication between tracking devices, databases, and software platforms.
* Improve application performance, scalability, and system reliability.
* Troubleshoot software defects and integration challenges.
* Participate in software testing, debugging, and code reviews.
* Collaborate with hardware engineers and software development teams.
* Maintain technical documentation and system architecture specifications.
* Support continuous improvements to existing software platforms.

Required Skills

* Experience with software engineering and systems development.
* Knowledge of C++, C#, Python, Java, or similar programming languages.
* Understanding of databases, APIs, and backend development.
* Familiarity with real-time data processing and system integration.
* Knowledge of networking and software communication protocols.
* Experience with debugging and software testing.
* Understanding of cloud-based or on-premises software systems.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

* Familiarity with wireless technologies, UWB, or RFID systems.

* Understanding of Agile development practices.

**Estimated Annual Salary:** $90,000 – $125,000, depending on experience, technical expertise, and responsibilities.

new_jobs.description:
**Position Summary:** Technology for Energy Corporation (TEC) is seeking a motivated and technically curious Entry-Level Systems Engineer to support the design, development, integration, testing, and support of technical products used in the aviation industry.

This position provides an opportunity to work across multiple engineering disciplines while contributing to the development and support of complex technical systems. The successful candidate will collaborate with experienced engineers and technical specialists to solve engineering problems, evaluate product performance, and support ongoing development projects.

As part of the onboarding and training process, the employee will participate in a structured cross-functional rotation through Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Hardware Engineering, and Sales/Technical Support. Each rotation will last approximately two months and provide hands-on experience with the products, processes, and technical responsibilities of each department.

Following the initial training period, the employee will continue in their Systems Engineering role, applying the knowledge gained across disciplines to support engineering projects and product development activities.

**Essential Functions**

The following duties are representative of the position and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities.

**Systems Engineering**

* Supports the design, development, integration, testing, and validation of engineering products and systems
* Applies engineering principles to investigate technical problems, evaluate potential solutions, and support design decisions
* Collaborates with software, aerospace, hardware, and technical support personnel on multidisciplinary engineering projects
* Assists in defining, documenting, and verifying system-level requirements
* Supports engineering testing, troubleshooting, data collection, and analysis
* Participates in engineering design reviews, technical discussions, and project meetings
* Prepares and maintains engineering documentation, test procedures, reports, and other technical deliverables
* Conducts technical research and evaluate components, technologies, and engineering solutions
* Assists with hardware and software integration and system-level troubleshooting
* Supports the investigation and resolution of technical issues identified during product development, testing, or customer use
* Follows established company engineering, quality, and safety procedures
* Completes assigned projects and responsibilities while demonstrating initiative, accountability, and a willingness to learn

  

**Initial Training and Development**

As part of the initial onboarding and professional development, TEC provides structured exposure to several technical disciplines. The training process includes approximately two-month rotations in the following areas:

**Software Engineering** - Gain exposure to software development, testing, debugging, and integration activities related to TEC's engineering products and systems.

**Aerospace Engineering** - Develop an understanding of aviation systems, vibration analysis, rotor balancing, engineering analysis, and the practical application of TEC's products.

**Hardware Engineering** - Gain practical experience with electronic circuit design, embedded systems, sensors, hardware prototyping, testing, and hardware/software integration.

**Sales and Technical Support** - Develop an understanding of customer applications, product requirements, technical troubleshooting, and the relationship between engineering development and customer needs.

Throughout this training process, the employee will work alongside experienced personnel, participate in ongoing projects, and develop the technical knowledge necessary to contribute effectively as a Systems Engineer.

The rotation schedule and assignments may be adjusted based on training needs and business priorities.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

None.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related engineering discipline
* Strong understanding of fundamental engineering principles
* Demonstrated analytical and technical problem-solving abilities
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a multidisciplinary environment
* Willingness to learn unfamiliar technical concepts, tools, and processes
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Ability to manage assigned tasks and meet project deadlines

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Previous engineering internship, cooperative education, or hands-on technical project experience
* Familiarity with systems engineering principles, including requirements development, integration, verification, and validation
* Experience with programming, electronics, mechanical systems, or aerospace applications
* Exposure to engineering analysis, laboratory testing, or technical troubleshooting
* Familiarity with CAD software, programming languages, electronic test equipment, or data analysis tools
* Interest in aviation, embedded systems, instrumentation, vibration analysis, or electromechanical product development
* Experience working on multidisciplinary engineering projects, including university senior design projects

  

**Desired Skills and Characteristics**

* Technical Curiosity – a genuine interest in understanding how products and systems work and how engineering decisions are made
* Problem-Solving - a logical and structured approach to analyzing and resolving technical challenges
* Adaptability - the ability to learn new technical concepts and work effectively across multiple engineering disciplines
* Initiative - a willingness to ask questions, seek information, and take ownership of assigned responsibilities

Kapsch is one of Austria's most successful global technology companies. With its comprehensive ITS (Intelligent Transportation Systems) portfolio, Kapsch is actively addressing the challenges of the present and the future with intelligent mobility solutions in a wide range of application areas. As a family-owned company founded in 1892 and headquartered in Vienna, Kapsch can look back on 130 years of experience with the future. To learn more about our solutions and innovations, visit our website here.

  
  
  

**Role Purpose**

As Lead Systems Engineer, you'll hold the highest level of technical ownership on our Systems Engineering track, joining a dispersed, cross-disciplinary team of hardware, software, and electrical engineers. You'll lead the technical delivery of complex, integrated tolling systems, bringing together roadside hardware, embedded devices, applications, and back-office software into a fully operational solution. This role requires someone with demonstrated experience delivering tolling systems in real-world environments, ideally having led major system delivery activities over multiple years. You'll take ownership from the bid and solution development phases through engineering, installation, integration, commissioning, and operational handoff. You'll be accountable for ensuring the technical solution is delivered to customer requirements, contractual commitments, quality expectations, and operational objectives.

  

You'll be the technical face of the client relationship, building trust with customer stakeholders throughout the life of a program while leading the engineering teams responsible for successful delivery. You'll own the requirements baseline, manage technical scope, coordinate complex hardware and software dependencies, and provide the technical direction needed to move programs forward.

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced machine learning engineer to join AIML Evaluation to build the systems that evaluate and refine Apple's foundation models and agents. In this role, you will build the systems that connect failure analysis to measurable model and agent improvements across a broad range of AI products at Apple.
